```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```

Now we have everything we need
```{r}
weather_df
```

Let's make a scatterplot
```{r}
ggplot(weather_df,aes(x=tmin,y=tmax))+
  geom_point()
```
```{r}
gg_temp_scatterplot=
  weather_df|>
    ggplot(aes(x=tmin,y=tmax,color=name))+
    geom_point(alpha=.25)+ #transparent
    geom_smooth(se=FALSE) #ggplot2 给图加一条平滑趋势线，同时不显示置信区间的阴影
gg_temp_scatterplot
```
show faceting
```{r}
weather_df|>
  ggplot(aes(x=tmin,y=tmax,color=name))+
  geom_point(alpha=.5)+ #transparent
  facet_grid(.~name)#facet_grid(行 ~ 列)
```
```{r}
weather_df|>
  ggplot(aes(x=tmin,y=tmax,color=name))+
  geom_point(alpha=.5)+ #transparent
  facet_grid(cols=vars(name))#facet_grid(行 ~ 列)
```
let's look at something else
```{r}
weather_df|>
  ggplot(aes(x=date,y=tmax,color=name))+#日期和最高温对应
  geom_point(alpha=.5)+
  geom_smooth(se=FALSE)+
  facet_grid(.~name)
```

```{r}
weather_df|>
  filter(name=="CentralPark_NY")|>
  mutate(
    tmax=tmax*9/5 + 32,
    tmin=tmin*9/5 + 32)|>
  ggplot(aes(x=tmax,y=tmin))+
  geom_point()
```
